cohort: Endothelial cells (ECs) isolated and cultured from placentas of pregnancies complicated by severe fetal growth restriction with abnormal umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry (FGRadv) and from gestational age-matched control placentas.
finding: VEGFA administration nominally improved FGRadv EC migration and tube formation, while ARNT overexpression enhanced ARNT expression in FGRadv ECs and partially rescued their migration and tube formation, suggesting other factors are also important in placental angiogenesis.
gest_age: Placentas were sourced from gestational age-matched control pregnancies.
